'''Lonnley Bolgar''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Beachcombers|Beachcomber]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] leader who lived on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He might be related to [[Phranis Bolgar]], a Beachcomber leader arrested by [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] agent [[Jonni Skaak|Jonthol Mazoon]]. At some point after the [[Raid on the Skaak Tipper Hideout|death]] of Jonthol Mazoon, a spacer killed Lonnley Bolgar.<ref name="SWG:TLaDoJS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lonnley Bolgar appeared as a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TLaDoJS" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Lonnley Bolgar was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]]" with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]", a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
